title: System Authentication & Login
purpose: Authenticate staff users using email/username and password credentials
offline_behavior: Allows PIN/token cached authentication when previously logged in; online required for fresh credentials
high_risk_operations: Account lockout after consecutive failed attempts
operator_notes: Ensure network connectivity to backend API; session tokens cached in localStorage.

title: Executive Dashboard & KPI Overview
purpose: Displays top-level sales, today's revenue, low stock alerts, receivables, and recent activity summaries
offline_behavior: Displays cached KPI summaries from IndexedDB when offline
operator_notes: Verify active branch context header to ensure KPIs reflect the desired operating unit.

title: Point of Sale (POS) Counter Checkout
purpose: High-speed front-counter retail/wholesale checkout, barcode scanning, split tender, and instant receipt generation
offline_behavior: Full offline checkout supported; sales queued in Dexie offline_sales store with temp IDs and client idempotency keys
high_risk_operations: Khata credit checkout without credit approval
operator_notes: Server calculates authoritative monetary totals and commits transaction before triggering thermal receipt print.

title: Sales History & Transaction Register
purpose: Browse, filter, reprint, cancel, or initiate returns for posted sale transactions
offline_behavior: Displays cached recent sales from local storage
high_risk_operations: Sale Cancellation (requires reason and restores stock)
operator_notes: Reprint uses immutable transaction-time snapshots persisted in sale_items.

title: Sale Returns & Refund Processing
purpose: Process customer merchandise returns, condition assessment (sellable/damaged/scrap), restock flags, and cash/khata refunds
offline_behavior: Online required for real-time customer balance and invoice validation
high_risk_operations: Classifying damaged items as non-restocked scrap
operator_notes: Restocked items immediately increment branch sellable inventory; damaged/scrap items bypass inventory.

title: Product Catalog & Master Management
purpose: Manage master products, categories, brands, wholesale/retail pricing, barcodes, and minimum stock alerts
offline_behavior: Read-only catalog cached in Dexie for offline POS search
high_risk_operations: Modifying base retail or wholesale pricing
operator_notes: Wholesale prices persisted via MIG-002 and synchronized across offline POS caches.

title: Product Category Hierarchy
purpose: Organize inventory hierarchy for visual POS grids and departmental revenue reporting
offline_behavior: Cached in Dexie categories store
operator_notes: Categories sync automatically during POS catalog refresh.

title: Product Brand Registry
purpose: Define manufacturer and brand taxonomies for filtering and purchase grouping
offline_behavior: Cached in Dexie brands store
operator_notes: Brands provide secondary classification for reporting.

title: Stock on Hand & Multi-Branch Inventory
purpose: View real-time physical stock by branch, cost valuation, low-stock indicators, and inventory history
offline_behavior: Shows local branch stock count from last sync
operator_notes: Stock quantities are derived from validated inventory movements and branch inventory balances.

title: Physical Stock Adjustments & Reconciliation
purpose: Record physical count variance, breakage, spoilage, or inventory reconciliation adjustments
offline_behavior: Online only to prevent concurrent multi-device count collision
operator_notes: Creates immutable inventory_movements record and re-evaluates weighted average unit cost.

title: Inter-Branch Stock Transfers
purpose: Initiate, dispatch, track in-transit, and receive stock shipments between company branches
offline_behavior: Online required for multi-branch transit synchronization
high_risk_operations: Transferring high-value stock out of source branch
operator_notes: Uses explicit transfer_status (in_transit -> received) via MIG-006 to eliminate phantom inventory.

title: Barcode & Price Label Printing
purpose: Generate and print adhesive barcode labels (Code128/EAN) with product title, SKU, and retail price
offline_behavior: Generates client-side SVG/Canvas barcodes for local printer output
operator_notes: Supports continuous roll and multi-label sheet thermal formats.

title: Customer Directory & CRM
purpose: Maintain customer master records, primary/secondary contact phones, credit limits, and addresses
offline_behavior: Cached in Dexie customers store; new customers can be created offline with temp IDs
operator_notes: Secondary phone persisted via MIG-010 and synchronized across offline stores.

title: Customer Khata Ledger & Credit Receivables
purpose: Review customer transactional credit ledger, post receivables payments, issue payment receipts, and audit balances
offline_behavior: Queues customer payment receipts in Dexie offline_khata store
operator_notes: Atomic double-entry updates ensure customers.balance matches historical account movements.

title: Procurement & Purchase Orders
purpose: Create supplier purchase orders, record incoming shipments, freight charges, landed costs, and supplier payments
offline_behavior: Online only for procurement authorization and supplier AP updates
high_risk_operations: Purchase Cancellation (strictly blocked if received stock was sold/transferred)
operator_notes: Freight and other charges persisted via MIG-005 and prorated across items to establish true landed cost.

title: Supplier Master & Payables Directory
purpose: Manage vendor contact profiles, tax numbers, opening balances, payment terms, and aggregate AP balances
offline_behavior: Read-only vendor list available locally
operator_notes: Supplier balance is calculated server-authoritatively from purchases, returns, and payment records.

title: Supplier AP Ledger & Payment Processing
purpose: Detailed vendor statement of accounts, recording disbursements, vendor debit notes, and payment reversals
offline_behavior: Online required for real-time bank ledger and AP settlement
high_risk_operations: Supplier Payment Reversal (restores AP and bank balance)
operator_notes: Supplier payment reversal endpoint implemented via GAP-012 and debit notes via MIG-008.

title: Operating Expense Management
purpose: Record and categorize operational overhead expenses, assign funding accounts, and track budget vs actuals
offline_behavior: Queues expenses in Dexie offline_expenses store
operator_notes: Server requires mandatory financial_account_id via MIG-004 to prevent untracked cash leakage.

title: Expense Categories & Departmental Budgets
purpose: Configure operational expense categories and assign monthly expenditure budget ceilings
offline_behavior: Read-only categories cached
operator_notes: Monthly budget target persisted via MIG-011 and supports budget variance reporting.

title: Standalone Product Invoice Prototype (Legacy)
purpose: Pre-remediation standalone print template; superseded by ThermalReceiptModal and A4InvoiceModal overlays
offline_behavior: N/A
operator_notes: Retained in repository as UNROUTED_BUT_RETAINED legacy code; operators print via modal overlays.

title: User Staff Governance & Payroll Setup
purpose: Manage staff accounts, assign system roles, branch permissions, and record employee wage/salary agreements
offline_behavior: Online only for security governance
high_risk_operations: Deactivating user with open POS cash drawer shift
operator_notes: Base salary, payment cycle, and next payment date persisted via MIG-009.

title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Permissions
purpose: Inspect system roles and granular module permission assignments
offline_behavior: Online only
operator_notes: Server kernel enforces policy guards regardless of client UI visibility.

title: Financial Accounts & Cash Ledgers
purpose: Manage physical cash drawers, bank accounts, digital wallets, account transfers, and capital transactions
offline_behavior: Read-only balance display offline
operator_notes: All movements create double-entry account_movements with unique compound references.

title: Store Branches & Outlets Management
purpose: Configure physical store outlets, branch addresses, contact numbers, and default financial registers
offline_behavior: Cached in app state
high_risk_operations: Deactivating branch with active inventory or pending transfers
operator_notes: Branch selection sets the active operating scope across POS, stock, and reports.

title: Enterprise Settings & Configuration
purpose: Configure business profile, currency symbol, default tax rates, invoice footers, and system preferences
offline_behavior: Settings cached in localStorage
operator_notes: Tenant settings apply across all branches unless overridden at branch level.

title: Hardware Printer & Peripherals Setup
purpose: Configure thermal receipt printer type (USB/Network/Bluetooth), paper width (80mm/58mm), and auto-print triggers
offline_behavior: Saved locally in browser device storage
operator_notes: Hardware print execution is strictly separated from transaction database commit.

title: Management Reports & Business Intelligence
purpose: Comprehensive reporting suite: Sales, Inventory Valuation, Khata Aging, Profit & Loss, Expenses, and Tax
offline_behavior: Online required for historical database aggregations
operator_notes: Reports strictly enforce tenant and branch boundary isolation.

title: Legacy Reports Redirect Surface
purpose: Redirects legacy /reports1 path to canonical /reports dashboard
offline_behavior: Redirects client-side to /reports
operator_notes: Maintained for backward route compatibility; canonical view is /reports.

title: Local Peer-to-Peer Device Pairing
purpose: Pair Desktop POS counter with Mobile Tablet POS via QR code and synchronize product catalog and local databases
offline_behavior: Operates over local Wi-Fi / LAN without internet access
operator_notes: Enforces strict RFC1918 same-LAN subnet validation and port safety checks (1024-65535).

title: Offline Queue & Sync Status Manager
purpose: Inspect pending offline queue items, manual sync triggers, conflict logs, and replay diagnostics
offline_behavior: Full local visibility of queued transactions and sync errors
high_risk_operations: Discarding rejected conflict items after manual review
operator_notes: Atomic temp-ID remapping and server authoritative validation ensure zero double-booking.

title: Analytics Alias Route
purpose: Legacy alias routing to executive dashboard /dashboard
offline_behavior: Redirects to /dashboard
operator_notes: Alias maintained for backward navigation compatibility.

title: Sales Counter Alias Route
purpose: Convenience root route directing cashier to /pos
offline_behavior: Redirects to /pos
operator_notes: Standard POS operational endpoint.

title: Inventory Management Alias Route
purpose: Convenience root route directing inventory controller to /inventory/products
offline_behavior: Redirects to /inventory/products
operator_notes: Standard catalog management endpoint.
